title: Skeleton Puzzle Canonical Representation
description: Crossword-shaped board of cells with a word list. Every word fills one slot (a maximal across or down run of 2+ cells), one kana per cell; crossing words share their kana. Small kana are written full-size.

cells.description: m x n lattice squares. 1 = a cell, 0 = not a cell.

words.description: The word list in print order. word: the kana as printed (small kana included); hint: the parenthesised text, shown but never placed.

marks.description: Double-framed cells for a prize question, display only.
